name: War Machines
desc:
In this open-world sandbox experience, you can:
» Fly through the skies in powerful armored WARDEN suits.
» Unlock new suit designs and abilities.
» Fight AI or other players.

Gamepad Controls:
» A (while Mid-Air) - Fly
» LJoystick In - Sprint
» LJoystick In (while Flying) - Boost
» RT (while Boosting) - Supersonic
» RT - Shoot
» DPad Up - Eject
» Dpad Down - Toggle Mask
» Dpad Left - Toggle Rogue mode (enables pvp)
» Dpad Right - Open Event Screen

PC Controls:
» Space (while Mid-Air) - Fly
» Ctrl (while Flying) - Boost
» Left Click (while Boosting) - Supersonic
» F - Block

This game is inspired by but not affiliated with Marvel's Ironman/Avengers

scripts.title: Silent Aim
scripts.script:
getgenv().AimTarget = "Both" -- Options: "Bot", "Player", "Both"
getgenv().AimWallbang = false


local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local LocalPlayer = game:GetService("Players").LocalPlayer
local Workspace = workspace
local Camera = Workspace.CurrentCamera


local function isTargetVisible(cameraPos, targetPos, ignoreList)
    local direction = (targetPos - cameraPos)
    local distance = direction.Magnitude
    if distance <= 0 then
        return true
    end
    direction = direction.Unit

    local params = RaycastParams.new()
    params.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Blacklist
    params.FilterDescendantsInstances = ignoreList
    params.IgnoreWater = true

    local rayResult = Workspace:Raycast(cameraPos, direction * (distance + 0.5), params)
    if rayResult == nil then
        return true
    end

    local hitInstance = rayResult.Instance
    if math.abs(rayResult.Distance - distance) < 1 then
        return true
    end

    local current = hitInstance
    while current do
        if current:IsA("Model") and current:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") then
            return true
        end
        current = current.Parent
    end

    return false
end

local function getBestTarget()
    local character = LocalPlayer.Character
    if not character then
        return {}
    end
    local primaryPart = character.PrimaryPart
    if not primaryPart then
        return {}
    end

    local cameraPos = Camera.CFrame.Position
    local screenCenter = Vector2.new(Camera.ViewportSize.X / 2, Camera.ViewportSize.Y / 2)

    local ignoreList = {character}
    for _, child in ipairs(character:GetChildren()) do
        if child:IsA("Tool") then
            table.insert(ignoreList, child)
        end
    end

    local allTargets = {}

    local function addTarget(charModel, hrp, isVisible)
        table.insert(allTargets, {
            character = charModel,
            hrp = hrp,
            isVisible = isVisible
        })
    end

    if getgenv().AimTarget == "Bot" or getgenv().AimTarget == "Both" then
        local missionsFolder = Workspace:FindFirstChild("Missions")
        if missionsFolder then
            for _, mission in ipairs(missionsFolder:GetChildren()) do
                local aiSpawners = mission:FindFirstChild("AISpawners")
                if aiSpawners then
                    for _, spawner in ipairs(aiSpawners:GetChildren()) do
                        local botModel = spawner:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("Model")
                        if botModel then
                            local humanoid = botModel:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
                            local hrp = botModel:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
                            if humanoid and hrp and humanoid.Health > 0 then
                                local visible = isTargetVisible(cameraPos, hrp.Position, ignoreList)
                                if visible then
                                    addTarget(botModel, hrp, true)
                                elseif getgenv().AimWallbang then
                                    addTarget(botModel, hrp, false)
                                end
                            end
                        end
                    end
                end
            end
        end
    end

    if getgenv().AimTarget == "Player" or getgenv().AimTarget == "Both" then
        for _, player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
            if player ~= LocalPlayer then
                local targetChar = player.Character
                if targetChar then
                    local humanoid = targetChar:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
                    local hrp = targetChar:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
                    if humanoid and hrp and humanoid.Health > 0 then
                        table.insert(ignoreList, targetChar)
                        local visible = isTargetVisible(cameraPos, hrp.Position, ignoreList)
                        if visible then
                            addTarget(targetChar, hrp, true)
                        elseif getgenv().AimWallbang then
                            addTarget(targetChar, hrp, false)
                        end
                    end
                end
            end
        end
    end

    local targetsWithDist = {}
    for _, target in ipairs(allTargets) do
        local screenPos, onScreen = Camera:WorldToScreenPoint(target.hrp.Position)
        if onScreen then
            target.screenDist = (Vector2.new(screenPos.X, screenPos.Y) - screenCenter).Magnitude
            table.insert(targetsWithDist, target)
        end
    end

    table.sort(targetsWithDist, function(a, b)
        if a.isVisible ~= b.isVisible then
            return a.isVisible
        end
        return a.screenDist < b.screenDist
    end)

    local result = {}
    for _, target in ipairs(targetsWithDist) do
        table.insert(result, target.character)
    end

    return result
end

local RaycastModule = require(game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage").Modules.Tool.Gun.Raycast)
local GetMouseHitModule = require(game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage").Modules.Tool.Raw.GetMouseHit)
pcall(restorefunction, RaycastModule.FireRay)
pcall(restorefunction, GetMouseHitModule)
local FireRay; FireRay = hookfunction(RaycastModule.FireRay, function(p1, p2, p3, p4, p5, p6, p7, p8)
    local bestTargets = getBestTarget()
    if #bestTargets > 0 then
        local v1, v2, v3, v4
        local target = bestTargets
        v1 = {target[1].HumanoidRootPart.Position}
        v2 = {}
        v3 = {}
        for _,v in ipairs(target) do
            table.insert(v2, {
                v,
                target[1].HumanoidRootPart.Position,
                (target[1].HumanoidRootPart.Position-game:GetService("Players").LocalPlayer.Character.PrimaryPart.Position).Unit,
                "Humanoid"
            })
            table.insert(v3, v.Humanoid)
        end
        v4 = {}
        return v1, v2, v3, v4
    else
        return FireRay(p1, p2, p3, p4, p5, p6, p7, p8)
    end
end)
local GetMouseHit; GetMouseHit = hookfunction(GetMouseHitModule, function(p1)
    local bestTargets = getBestTarget()
    if #bestTargets > 0 then
        return bestTargets[1].HumanoidRootPart.Position
    else
        return GetMouseHit(p1)
    end
end)

scripts.title: auto farms bots
scripts.script:
local function StartAutoFarm()
    getgenv().WarMachinesExecuted = true
    local lp = game.Players.LocalPlayer
    local char = lp.Character or lp.CharacterAdded:Wait()
    local vinput = game:GetService("VirtualInputManager")
    local priorities = {"sniper", "elite", "bandit"}
 
    task.spawn(function()
        while getgenv().WarMachinesExecuted do
            local found = false
            for _, priority in ipairs(priorities) do
                for _, npc in pairs(workspace:GetDescendants()) do
                    if npc:IsA("Model") and npc:FindFirstChild("Humanoid") and npc:FindFirstChild("Head") then
                        local name = tostring(npc.Name):lower()
                        if name:find(priority) and npc.Humanoid.Health > 0 then
                            local head = npc.Head
                            char:PivotTo(head.CFrame * CFrame.new(0, 0, 5))
                            vinput:SendMouseButtonEvent(0, 0, 0, true, game, 1)
                            task.wait(0.1)
                            vinput:SendMouseButtonEvent(0, 0, 0, false, game, 1)
                            task.wait(0.3)
                            found = true
                            break
                        end
                    end
                end
                if found then break end
            end
            task.wait(0.4)
        end
    end)
end
 
-- Função para parar o Auto Farm
local function StopAutoFarm()
    getgenv().WarMachinesExecuted = false
end
 
-- GUI Pain or Hope
local gui = Instance.new("ScreenGui", game.CoreGui)
gui.Name = "PainOrHopeFarm"
 
local frame = Instance.new("Frame", gui)
frame.Size = UDim2.new(0, 240, 0, 130)
frame.Position = UDim2.new(0, 30, 0, 150)
frame.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(10, 10, 10)
frame.BorderSizePixel = 0
frame.Active = true
frame.Draggable = true
 
local title = Instance.new("TextLabel", frame)
title.Text = "Pain or Hope"
title.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 35)
title.BackgroundTransparency = 1
title.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(180, 0, 255)
title.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
title.TextScaled = true
 
local toggle = Instance.new("TextButton", frame)
toggle.Size = UDim2.new(1, -40, 0, 40)
toggle.Position = UDim2.new(0, 20, 0, 50)
toggle.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(40, 0, 70)
toggle.TextColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
toggle.Text = "Start Auto Farm"
toggle.Font = Enum.Font.Gotham
toggle.TextScaled = true
 
local active = false
 
toggle.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
    active = not active
    if active then
        toggle.Text = "Stop Auto Farm"
        StartAutoFarm()
    else
        toggle.Text = "Start Auto Farm"
        StopAutoFarm()
    end
end)

scripts.title: ProBaconHub
scripts.script:
getgenv().WarMachinesExecuted = not getgenv().WarMachinesExecuted
getgenv().TweenTeleportTakenTime = 0.5
getgenv().Return = false
getgenv().AutoCooldown = true

if getgenv().WarMachinesExecuted then
    game.Players.LocalPlayer.Character.HumanoidRootPart.CFrame = CFrame.new(500, 700, 265)
    task.wait(0.1)
    game:GetService('VirtualInputManager'):SendKeyEvent(true, Enum.KeyCode.Space, false, game)
    task.wait(0.1)
    game:GetService('VirtualInputManager'):SendKeyEvent(false, Enum.KeyCode.Space, false, game)
    task.wait(0.1)
    game:GetService('VirtualInputManager'):SendKeyEvent(true, Enum.KeyCode.Space, false, game)
    task.wait(0.1)
    game:GetService('VirtualInputManager'):SendKeyEvent(false, Enum.KeyCode.Space, false, game)
    task.wait(0.1)
    game:GetService('VirtualInputManager'):SendKeyEvent(true, Enum.KeyCode.LeftShift, false, game)
    task.wait(0.0001)
    game:GetService('VirtualInputManager'):SendKeyEvent(false, Enum.KeyCode.LeftShift, false, game)
    getgenv().PlrVelocity = Instance.new("BodyVelocity")
    getgenv().PlrVelocity.Parent = game.Workspace.Characters[game.Players.LocalPlayer.Name].LowerTorso
    getgenv().PlrVelocity.MaxForce = Vector3.new(math.huge, math.huge, math.huge)
    Loops = 0
    Direction = 1
    while true do
        if not getgenv().WarMachinesExecuted then
            break
        end
        Loops = Loops + 1
        if Loops == 40 and getgenv().Return == true then
            Direction = Direction * -1
            Loops = 0
        else
            getgenv().PlrVelocity.Velocity = Vector3.new(0, 1250 * Direction, 0)
            task.wait(0.5)
        end
		getgenv().PlrVelocity.Velocity = Vector3.new(0,100,0)
		if game.Players.LocalPlayer.Character:GetAttribute("Overheat") ~= nil then
        	if getgenv().AutoCooldown and game.Players.LocalPlayer.Character:GetAttribute("Overheat") >= 900 then
        	    repeat
        	        game.Players.LocalPlayer.Character.HumanoidRootPart.CFrame = CFrame.new(-830.82, 285, -509.22)
        	        if game.Players.LocalPlayer.PlayerGui.Client.SideBar.Visible == true and game.Players.LocalPlayer.PlayerGui.Hotbar.Enabled == true then
        	            game:GetService('VirtualInputManager'):SendKeyEvent(true, Enum.KeyCode.Space, false, game)
        	            task.wait(0.1)
        	            game:GetService('VirtualInputManager'):SendKeyEvent(false, Enum.KeyCode.Space, false, game)
        	            task.wait(0.1)
        	            if game.Players.LocalPlayer.PlayerGui.Client.SideBar.Visible == true and game.Players.LocalPlayer.PlayerGui.Hotbar.Enabled == true then
        	                game:GetService('VirtualInputManager'):SendKeyEvent(true, Enum.KeyCode.LeftShift, false, game)
        	                task.wait(0.0001)
        	                game:GetService('VirtualInputManager'):SendKeyEvent(false, Enum.KeyCode.LeftShift, false, game)
        	                task.wait(0.1)
        	                if game.Players.LocalPlayer.PlayerGui.Client.SideBar.Visible == true and game.Players.LocalPlayer.PlayerGui.Hotbar.Enabled == true then
        	                    game:GetService('VirtualInputManager'):SendKeyEvent(true, Enum.KeyCode.Space, false, game)
        	                    task.wait(0.1)
        	                    game:GetService('VirtualInputManager'):SendKeyEvent(false, Enum.KeyCode.Space, false, game)
        	                    task.wait(0.1)
        	                    game:GetService('VirtualInputManager'):SendKeyEvent(true, Enum.KeyCode.LeftShift, false, game)
        	                    task.wait(0.0001)
        	                    game:GetService('VirtualInputManager'):SendKeyEvent(false, Enum.KeyCode.LeftShift, false, game)
        	                    task.wait(0.1)
        	                end
        	            end
        	        end
        	        task.wait(0.01)
        	    until game.Players.LocalPlayer.Character:GetAttribute("Overheat") <= 50 or not getgenv().WarMachinesExecuted
        	end
		end
        if game.Players.LocalPlayer.PlayerGui.Client.SideBar.Visible == true and game.Players.LocalPlayer.PlayerGui.Hotbar.Enabled == true then
            game:GetService('VirtualInputManager'):SendKeyEvent(true, Enum.KeyCode.Space, false, game)
            task.wait(0.1)
            game:GetService('VirtualInputManager'):SendKeyEvent(false, Enum.KeyCode.Space, false, game)
            task.wait(0.1)
            if game.Players.LocalPlayer.PlayerGui.Client.SideBar.Visible == true and game.Players.LocalPlayer.PlayerGui.Hotbar.Enabled == true then
                game:GetService('VirtualInputManager'):SendKeyEvent(true, Enum.KeyCode.LeftShift, false, game)
                task.wait(0.0001)
                game:GetService('VirtualInputManager'):SendKeyEvent(false, Enum.KeyCode.LeftShift, false, game)
                task.wait(0.1)
                if game.Players.LocalPlayer.PlayerGui.Client.SideBar.Visible == true and game.Players.LocalPlayer.PlayerGui.Hotbar.Enabled == true then
                    game:GetService('VirtualInputManager'):SendKeyEvent(true, Enum.KeyCode.Space, false, game)
                    task.wait(0.1)
                    game:GetService('VirtualInputManager'):SendKeyEvent(false, Enum.KeyCode.Space, false, game)
                    task.wait(0.1)
                    game:GetService('VirtualInputManager'):SendKeyEvent(true, Enum.KeyCode.LeftShift, false, game)
                    task.wait(0.0001)
                    game:GetService('VirtualInputManager'):SendKeyEvent(false, Enum.KeyCode.LeftShift, false, game)
                end
            end
        end
    end
else
    getgenv().PlrVelocity.Velocity = Vector3.new(0,0,0)
    game:GetService("TweenService"):Create(game.Players.LocalPlayer.Character.HumanoidRootPart ,TweenInfo.new(getgenv().TweenTeleportTakenTime),{CFrame = CFrame.new(500, 700, 265)}):Play()
    task.wait(getgenv().TweenTeleportTakenTime)
    getgenv().PlrVelocity:Destroy()
	game.Players.LocalPlayer.Character.HumanoidRootPart.Velocity = Vector3.new(0,-10,0)
	task.wait(.25)
    game.Players.LocalPlayer.Character.HumanoidRootPart.CFrame = CFrame.new(500, 640, 265)
end
